main_issue: Who gets leave on the working day before/after Hari Raya Puasa (especially the first day), given only two staff can be off... actually two must be on duty, so only two can be off; resolved with D giving up the first day.

A-B.evidence: T11-T20: both insist on needing first day, B rebuts A ('Not simple isn't impossible'); T22-23 D yields, A accepts, B thanks D, but A and B never settle between themselves.

A-C.evidence: C offers to work Hari Raya days (T7, T9); A doesn't object and accepts the final arrangement (T23); little direct interaction.

A-D.evidence: T16 D also needs first day; T22 D gives it up and says he'll work with C; A: 'Thanks, Agent D. That works then' (T23).

B-C.evidence: C offers to work Hari Raya (T7, T9); B ends satisfied with the arrangement (T26); no direct exchange.

B-D.evidence: T22 D: 'If you have no one for your kid, you should take the day'; T26 B: 'Agent D, thank you. Really.'

C-D.evidence: T7-T10 C and D agree swap Hari Raya/Christmas; T22 D agrees to work with C on first day.
